scope: Offline MLUT allocation-to-encoder provenance and native HEIF output ownership
network_exception: User-requested Git push and remote ref verification only, after offline work.
host_emulation: Selected original instructions in Unicorn with explicit synthetic inputs and external-service stubs; no MMIO, real DMM, codec, IPC or imaging hardware.

checklist.question: CP MLUT allocation and derived-handle consumer
checklist.finding: Conditional ring or DMM allocation; continuous allocation-to-share fragment recovered; live globals and export to encoder unknown.

checklist.question: av-cam encoder pixel inputs
checklist.finding: Resize output writes exact encoder input handle slots; extent/address conversion recovered; MLUT producer lineage missing.

checklist.question: Native av-cam MLUT boundary
checklist.finding: 64 diagnostic registrations and dimension wrapper mapped; no allocation-bearing still route or physical-alias proof.

checklist.question: HEIF encode completion to published areas
checklist.finding: Direct native request bypasses generic AP converter; completion length, Post, tracker detach, publication and codec close recovered. Real codec and grid metadata not executed.

checklist.question: AP recording resource ownership
checklist.finding: Same HEIF areas participate in non-cache share-before-free and deduplication; real refcounts and final shared-reference reclamation unobserved.

not_proven: Live CP MLUT allocation/share/export into av-cam still or resize input
Live mode selection and pixel color domain
Full-resolution LUT processing or saved-image effect
DMM coherency, cancellation and final receiver-side shared-reference reclamation
Working custom-program codec API or on-camera behavior
publication_excludes: Official firmware downloads and extracted images
Ignored local toolchains, logs and Ghidra build databases
Camera backups and private calibration data
